text:
Tara: quick design review 11 I've prototyped a condensed connectivity step for the Private wizard focusing on non-admin users. Figma link: /figma/onprem/connectivity-condensed. Want concise copy + accessibility checks.
Leo: nice direction. key thing: translate technical probe results into actionable steps for non-network folks. e.g., instead of 'icmp timeout' show 'No response from our endpoint 11 check your firewall or proxy settings'.
Mia: agree. also add a small toggle 'Show technical details' for SREs. default to plain language for most users.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) status text must be visible and announced (role=status + aria-live=polite); 2) toggles must be keyboard accessible with clear aria-expanded state; 3) ensure color contrasts and that icons have aria-hidden where appropriate.
Tara: proposed primary copy: "Checking outbound access to Redwood1 This won't change your network." failure helpline: "If blocked: try opening outbound port 443 or contact your network admin." action labels: 'Quick check (<20s)' and 'Run detailed trace (2-3 min)'.
Leo: UX: when a non-admin sees 'Blocked', show a second line: 'Need help? Share anonymized diagnostics with support.' hitting share should open a tiny dialog that lists what gets sent and an option to redact hostnames.
Support-bot: automated-probe 1799990060 result=TIMEOUT target=api.redwood:443 probe=tcp hops=5
Mia: for the share dialog include a sample redacted snippet so users know what support will see. also include a checkbox 'Remove hostnames' default true.
Tara: accessibility + copy note: the share button should read 'Share anonymized diagnostics' (avoid 'Send' which sounds permanent). include a one-line privacy link.
Leo: interaction note: quick check should show a micro-progress bar with states 'probing 1 analyzing 1 result' to avoid blank spinner. and show toast 'Quick check usually finishes under 20s'.
a11y-bot: extra: ensure the micro-progress states are announced as they change for screen reader users, but throttle announcements to avoid noisy updates.
Mia: mobile: collapse actions into a single column and put the help link under the result. copy and raw-download controls full width.
Tara: acceptance for eng: 1) implement quick vs detailed endpoints; 2) plain-language first with collapsed technical details; 3) consent dialog with redaction toggle and sample payload; 4) aria-live status + announced micro-progress; 5) telemetry: default summarized hops only; full traces only with explicit consent.
Leo: i'll update the figma and add the sample redacted blob.
Mia: i'll coordinate with privacy on exact wording for the consent checkbox.
Tara: thanks team 1 plan to hand off to eng in tomorrow's sync. tagging @leo for final copy polish. :sparkles:
